Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 16
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misquoted/misinterpreted the Britannica article, falsely claiming it stated the Bering Sea and Strait were named for Peter the Great. This fabricated or incorrect extraction contradicted authoritative information (including Britannica itself) that the Bering Sea is named after Vitus Bering. This misstatement directly led the Planner to produce the wrong final answer.
